name: Linear System Uniqueness Constraint
description: Replaces the explicit inequality (e_u - e_v)^2 >= 1 with a requirement that a 2x2 system of linear equations parameterized by s_u and s_v has a unique solution. This perfectly encodes s_u != s_v via the matrix determinant (s_u - s_v != 0), forcing models to algebraically deduce the disequality constraint rather than pattern-matching a graph coloring inequality.
